name: Hero Rush 3D
blurb: Knights, mages and rogues race for the coins, jump each other's swings and knock the loot loose. Sixty-second rounds that never stop, in three.js with free CC0 animated characters.

landing.pitch: Grab the coins. Jump their swings. Knock the loot loose.

controls.phone: Drag anywhere to run; Jump and Swing at the bottom right.
controls.computer: WASD or arrows to run, Space to jump, F or a click to swing.
